## Glossary

a Slope of the F/v relationship

b $y$-axis intercept of the F/v relationship

BLC Blood lactate concentration

$\mathrm{B L C}_{i}^{-1}$ (P) Relationship between blood lactate concentration and power output at cadence i

$\mathrm{B L C}_{m a x}$ Post-exercise maximum blood lactate concentration

bpm Heartbeats per minute, nit of heart rate

CE Caloric equivalent

$\mathrm{C}_{E H R i}$ Cycling efficiency for heart rate

$\mathrm{C}_{E V O_{2} i}$ Cycling efficiency for oxygen uptake

F Force, mean pedal force

FC Fast component

$\mathrm{F}_{m a x}$ Theoretical maximum mean pedal force

$\mathrm{F A T}_{m a x}$ Work rate associated with the peak fat oxidation

F/v Force-velocity relationship

h Hour

$\mathrm{H C O}_{3}$ Bicarbonate

HI High-intensity, power output at or above 90% of power output at maximum oxygen uptake

HR Heart rate

$\mathrm{H R}_{B a s e}$ Baseline level of heart rate

$\mathrm{H R}_{i}^{-1}$ (P) Relationship between heart rate and power output at cadence i

$\mathrm{H R}_{i j}$ Cadence- and workrate-dependent heart rate

Hz Hertz, unit of frequency

i Pedaling rate: $i \in\{60; 90; 120\}$

kg Kilogram, unit of mass

L Litre

LT1 First lactate threshold, highest work rate without significant blood lactate accumulation

j Work rate: $j \in\{1 0 0; \dots ; \mathrm{P V O}_{2 m a x}\}$

m Meter, unit of distance

M Mean value

$\eta^{2}$ Eta squared

MC Medium component

min Minute

ml Milliliter

$\mu l$ Microliter

MLSS Maximum lactate steady state

mmol $1^{-1}$ Millimole per liter of whole blood

N Newton, unit of force

P/v Power-velocity relationship

$\mathrm{P}_{m a x}$ Maximum power output

$\mathbf{P}_{\mathrm{peak}}$ Highest measured power output

$\mathbf{pCO}_{2}$ Partial pressure of carbon dioxide

N Newton, unit of force

P/v Power-velocity relationship

$\mathrm{P}_{m a x}$ Maximum power output

$\mathbf{P}_{\mathrm{peak}}$ Highest measured power output

$\mathbf{pCO}_{2}$ Partial pressure of carbon dioxide

$\mathbf{pH}$ Potential of hydrogen, unit of acidity

$\mathbf{P}_{INT}$ Internal power expenditure

$\mathbf{PR}_{i}$ Specific pedaling rate, where the index indicates the referred value

$\mathbf{PR}_{\mathrm{max}}$ Maximum cadence, maximum pedaling rate

$\mathbf{PR}_{\mathrm{opt}}$ Cadence at maximal power output, optimal pedaling rate

$\mathbf{P}\dot{\mathrm{VO}}_{2\max}$ Power output at maximum oxygen uptake

$\mathbf{r}$ Crank length

$R^{2}$ Coefficient of correlation

$\mathbf{RER}$ Respiratory exchange ratio

$\mathbf{RER}_{ij}$ Cadence- and workrate-dependent respiratory exchange ratio

$\mathbf{rpm}$ Crank revolutions per minute

$\mathbf{s}$ Second

$\mathbf{SC}$ Slow component

$\mathbf{SD}$ Standard deviation

$\tau$ Tau, time constant of kinetic

$\mathbf{VE}$ Minute ventilation

$\dot{\mathrm{VE}}\cdot\mathrm{VO}_{2}^{-1}$ Minute ventilation to oxygen uptake ratio

$\dot{\mathrm{vLa}}_{\mathrm{max}}$ Maximal rate of lactate accumulation

$\dot{\mathrm{VO}}_{2}$ Oxygen uptake

$\dot{\mathrm{VO}}_{2_{\mathrm{Base}}}$ Baseline level of oxygen uptake

$\dot{\mathrm{VO}}_{2_{\mathrm{max}}}$ Test specific maximal oxygen uptake

$\dot{\mathrm{VO}}_{2_{ij}}$ Cadence- and work rate-dependent oxygen uptake

$\dot{\mathrm{VO}}_{2_{\mathrm{i}}}^{-1}(\mathbf{P})$ Relationship between oxygen uptake and power output at cadence i

$\mathbf{W}$ Watt, unit of power

$\mathbf{W}\mathrm{kg}^{-1}$ Relative power output, watt per kilogram of bodyweight

$\mathbf{W}_{\mathrm{MET}}$ Metabolic cost

$\Delta_{\mathrm{BLC}}$ Blood lactate accumulation
